note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Record in the array order: the state the check sees depends on it. The two templates that need certtmpl.msc (LabWebServer, LabShortLived) are made by the owner (the AD CS cmdlets cannot duplicate a template). Tear-down restores the pre-ep09 checkpoints and deletes CON-CA01.
prepare: foreach ($v in 'CON-DC01', 'CON-SRV01', 'CON-SRV02', 'CON-SQL01') { if (-not (Get-VMSnapshot -VMName $v -Name pre-ep09 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Checkpoint-VM -Name $v -SnapshotName pre-ep09 } }
$s = New-PSSession -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred
Invoke-Command -Session $s { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep09 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Copy-Item -ToSession $s -Path (Get-Location).Path -Destination C:\lab\ep09 -Recurse -Force
Invoke-Command -Session $s { Install-WindowsFeature RSAT-ADCS -IncludeAllSubFeature | Out-Null }
Remove-PSSession $s
# CON-CA01 (Server Core, domain-joined, 10.50.0.43) is created by the owner like the other lab VMs: see needs vm:CON-CA01
if (-not (Get-VMSnapshot -VMName CON-CA01 -Name pre-ep09 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Checkpoint-VM -Name CON-CA01 -SnapshotName pre-ep09 }
Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { Invoke-Command -ComputerName CON-CA01 { hostname } }

screens.name: ca-build
commands: Invoke-Command -ComputerName CON-CA01 { Get-Service CertSvc; certutil -CAInfo name }

screens.name: check-before
prepare: # owner: on CON-SRV02 open certtmpl.msc and duplicate Web Server as LabWebServer (Subject Name: Supply in the request; Extensions > Application Policies: add Client Authentication; Security: Domain Computers Enroll)
# owner: duplicate Computer as LabShortLived (validity 10 days, renewal 2 days, Domain Computers Enroll, autoenroll off)
Read-Host 'Press Enter when both templates exist' | Out-Null
Invoke-Command -VMName CON-CA01 -Credential $cred { Add-CATemplate -Name LabWebServer -Force; Add-CATemplate -Name LabShortLived -Force }
Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV01 -Credential $cred { Get-Certificate -Template LabShortLived -CertStoreLocation Cert:\LocalMachine\My | Out-Null }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { New-SelfSignedCertificate -Subject "CN=Lab Test Portal" -DnsName portal.lab.contoso.com -CertStoreLocation Cert:\LocalMachine\My -NotAfter (Get-Date).AddDays(9) | Out-Null }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SQL01 -Credential $cred { New-SelfSignedCertificate -Subject "CN=CON-SQL01 legacy" -KeyLength 1024 -HashAlgorithm SHA1 -NotBefore (Get-Date).AddDays(-400) -NotAfter (Get-Date).AddDays(-1) -CertStoreLocation Cert:\LocalMachine\My | Out-Null }
Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { certutil -pulse | Out-Null }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 120

screens.name: cdp-http
commands: Invoke-Command -ComputerName CON-SRV01 { $c = Get-Certificate -Template Machine -CertStoreLocation Cert:\LocalMachine\My; Export-Certificate -Cert $c.Certificate -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\srv01.cer | Out-Null }

screens.name: renew
prepare: # owner: in certtmpl.msc set LabWebServer back to "Build from this Active Directory information" and remove Client Authentication, so the High finding disappears at the re-check
Read-Host 'Press Enter when the LabWebServer template is fixed' | Out-Null

teardown: foreach ($v in 'CON-DC01', 'CON-SRV01', 'CON-SRV02', 'CON-SQL01') { Restore-VMSnapshot -VMName $v -Name pre-ep09 -Confirm:$false; Remove-VMSnapshot -VMName $v -Name pre-ep09 }

$vm = Get-VM -Name CON-CA01 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($vm) { $disks = @($vm | Get-VMHardDiskDrive | ForEach-Object Path | Where-Object { (Split-Path $_ -Leaf) -like "CON-CA01*" }); Stop-VM -VM $vm -TurnOff -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-VM -VM $vm -Force; foreach ($d in $disks) { Get-ChildItem (Split-Path $d) -File -Filter "CON-CA01*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
